headers.//: The worker must never be served from cache. A stale one stays in charge and keeps handing out the assets it cached, which no later deploy can dislodge.

This app ships an ES module graph with no content hashes in the filenames. Cached modules paired with fresh ones produce a build that imports symbols its dependency does not export yet. no-cache still allows a 304 against Hosting's ETag, so revalidation is cheap — it is freshness that is mandatory, not re-download.
Images never change without the filename changing.
